# Benchmark hardware

All results in the paper were measured on one shared node:

- GPU: NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB (one of four used; driver 590.48.01)
- CPU: 4 × Intel Xeon Platinum 8276L @ 2.20 GHz (28 cores per socket, 2 threads per core)
- Linux kernel 5.14 (RHEL 9)

The node was shared with other users, so absolute timings can vary by a few percent between runs.
